note: PaveDB configuration schema: the single source of truth for config keys, their defaults, and descriptions. Edit only to add or change a config field, then run `make docs-refresh` to regenerate config.yml.example and docs/reference/config.md. This is NOT an operator tuning file and is not meant to be edited while running: configure a live instance via config.yml or PAVEDB_* environment variables.

fields.description: Root directory for local catalog, metadata, document chunks, and indexes. When omitted at runtime, defaults to the instance home data directory.
Allow searches to include the configured common collection when requested.
Tenant that owns the common collection.
Collection name used for common shared results.
Enable persisted query history and query-home lookup pointers.
Max open collection backend and metadata handles; values below 1 become 1.
Max runtime embedder instances in the hot cache; active collections stay pinned.
Enable development startup behavior such as allowing auth.mode=none on loopback and verbose PaveDB logging.
Authentication mode. Use static outside dev; none is accepted only under the startup policy's dev safeguards.

Tenant label assigned to unauthenticated requests when auth.mode is none. Tenant names must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$ (lowercase ASCII, digits and hyphen) -- the same rule as collection names. Lowercase-only keeps a name from colliding with another under case folding or Unicode normalization on case-insensitive filesystems (APFS, NTFS, SMB), where two such tenants would otherwise share one data directory.
Admin bearer token. Server startup generates admin.key when omitted.

Map of tenant name to bearer token when auth.mode is static. Set PAVEDB_AUTH__API_KEYS to a JSON object (for example, {"acme":"secret"}) or set individual keys with PAVEDB_AUTH__API_KEYS__<TENANT>. Tenant names must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$ (lowercase ASCII, digits and hyphen) -- the same rule as collection names. Lowercase-only keeps a name from colliding with another under case folding or Unicode normalization on case-insensitive filesystems (APFS, NTFS, SMB), where two such tenants would otherwise share one data directory. To revoke a tenant's key, delete its entry from the tenants file, set a new value, or set it to null in config.yml or the JSON environment map; null also removes a key that only the tenants file supplies. Environment override names are case-folded and match an existing config key case-insensitively.
Optional sidecar YAML file containing auth.api_keys and tenants.* values.
Vector store backend used for local indexes.
Default embedder selector. Use a user-defined instance key, type, type:model, or full vector key. Required when more than one embedder instance is configured.

How each collection load chooses among configured instances in the same vector space. First uses config order; round_robin rotates; weighted rotates by each instance weight; failover tries in order until one initializes. Routing is runtime-only and is never persisted in collection catalog state.

Operator preference: one or more configured embedder instances (comma-separated or a list) tried in order for this operation class (ingest); the first instance sharing the collection's vector space runs it — one entry per model family. Nothing compatible, or the preferred instance unable to serve, falls back to embedder.routing.policy. Never a caller choice.

Operator preference: one or more configured embedder instances (comma-separated or a list) tried in order for this operation class (search); the first instance sharing the collection's vector space runs it — one entry per model family. Nothing compatible, or the preferred instance unable to serve, falls back to embedder.routing.policy. Never a caller choice.

Operator preference: one or more configured embedder instances (comma-separated or a list) tried in order for this operation class (maintenance); the first instance sharing the collection's vector space runs it — one entry per model family. Nothing compatible, or the preferred instance unable to serve, falls back to embedder.routing.policy. Never a caller choice.
Warm the default embedder at server startup before the first query. Null uses the startup policy: enabled outside dev, disabled in dev.
Built-in native embedder instance type. Native means PaveDB runs the embedder itself rather than calling an external service.
Default sentence-transformers model for the native instance.
Positive routing weight for the native instance when embedder.routing.policy is weighted. Custom instances accept the same sibling field.
Native SBERT runtime mode: auto, process, or direct. On macOS with FAISS, auto selects process; direct is blocked.
Optional native SBERT device override; cpu | cuda | mps | auto lets the adapter choose.
Optional native SBERT encode batch size; null uses the adapter default.

Pass `trust_remote_code=True` to Sentence-Transformers when loading the model. Required by models with custom architectures (for example `nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5`). Execution detail; not part of the vector-space identity, and not inherited by a collection that names a different model.

TEI-compatible `/embed` server used when `runtime` is `remote`. The remote server must run the identical model in float32; the endpoint is not part of the vector-space identity, so numerical equivalence with local runtimes is the operator's contract.
Prefix prepended to query texts before encoding (e5-style `query: `). Changes produced vectors and therefore participates in the vector-space identity.
Prefix prepended to passage texts before encoding (e5-style `passage: `). Changes produced vectors and therefore participates in the vector-space identity.
Native SBERT process worker count; auto picks a conservative local default capped for mixed search/ingest tail stability.
Reject document uploads larger than this many megabytes; 0 disables the limit.
Reject a batch ingest request whose documents add up to more than this many megabytes of text; null uses ingest.max_file_size_mb, 0 disables the limit.
Maximum number of concurrent ingest operations; 0 disables the cap.

Maximum share of ingest.max_concurrent that one tenant may hold. 0 (the default) disables the share: any tenant may fill the whole ingest pool, which is what a single-tenant instance wants. Set it on a shared instance, where one tenant filling the pool starves every other. Note ingest.max_concurrent (7) is smaller than tenants.default_max_concurrent (42), so the per-tenant request cap cannot bind on ingest and this is the only per-tenant ingest bound.
Collection archive dumps/restores running at once on this instance; 0 disables the bound. Archives read or rebuild a whole collection, so the default stays small.
Collection archive operations one tenant may run at once; 0 disables the bound.
Reindex jobs running at once on this instance; 0 disables the bound. A reindex re-embeds a whole collection.
Reindex jobs one tenant may run at once; 0 disables the bound.
Maximum number of concurrent search operations; 0 disables the cap.

Maximum share of search.max_concurrent that one tenant may hold. 0 (the default) disables the share: any tenant may fill the whole search pool, which is what a single-tenant instance wants. Set it on a shared instance, where one tenant filling the pool starves every other. Note search.max_concurrent (42) is not smaller than tenants.default_max_concurrent (42), so the per-tenant request cap only binds once a tenant already holds the entire pool. A search costs far less than an ingest, so this share can be generous: about two thirds of the pool still leaves room for the other tenants. A request over this share is refused with 503 search_overloaded; a request over tenants.default_max_concurrent is refused earlier, with 429 tenant_rate_limited.
Per-search timeout in milliseconds; 0 disables the timeout.

Search modes this instance serves. vector ranks by vector similarity alone; boost adds an exact-token nudge inside the vector candidate window; hybrid fuses vector and full-text rankings. Must include vector. A collection's default mode and any requested mode must be listed here, or the search answers 400 search_mode_disabled.
Largest score the boost mode adds, for a chunk matching every query token; a chunk matching m of n tokens gains weight * m / n. Must be greater than 0 and at most 1.

Chunking strategies collections may choose at creation. fixed cuts free text into overlapping windows of characters; none keeps each text as one chunk, for callers that chunk before ingesting. PDF pages and CSV rows stay one chunk each under either.
Smallest chunk size, in characters, a collection may choose for the fixed strategy.
Largest chunk size, in characters, a collection may choose for the fixed strategy; also the longest text the none strategy accepts as one chunk (longer is 400 chunk_too_large).
Smallest overlap, in characters, a collection may choose for the fixed strategy.
Largest overlap, in characters, a collection may choose for the fixed strategy. Any chosen overlap must also be at most a quarter of the chosen size.
Strategy for collections created without one; must be listed in chunking.strategies.
fixed chunk size for collections that do not name one.
fixed chunk overlap for collections that do not name one.
Default per-tenant concurrent request cap; 0 disables the cap.
Default moving-window request limit per tenant and minute; 0 disables the limit. Per-tenant max_rpm in tenants.yml overrides it.
Default moving-window request limit per tenant and hour; 0 disables the limit. Per-tenant max_rph in tenants.yml overrides it.
Default per-tenant collection-count limit enforced at creation; 0 disables the cap. Per-tenant max_collections in tenants.yml overrides it.
Default cap on indexed chunks per collection enforced at ingest; 0 disables the cap. Per-tenant max_chunks_per_collection in tenants.yml overrides it.

Default cap on indexed chunks across all of a tenant's collections, enforced at ingest; 0 disables the cap. Per-tenant max_chunks_per_tenant in tenants.yml overrides it. This is the tenant's storage ceiling: max_chunks_per_collection alone bounds one collection, so a tenant allowed several has no ceiling without this.

Collection archive operations (dump or restore) a tenant may start per day; 0 = unlimited. Override per tenant as tenants.<name>.max_archives_per_day. Charged on the persistent per-operation rate window.
Reindex jobs a tenant may start per 30 days; 0 = unlimited. Override per tenant as tenants.<name>.max_reindex_per_month. Charged on the persistent per-operation rate window.
Default server bind host after startup policy enforcement.
Default server bind port.
Enable uvicorn reload when running the packaged server.
Number of Uvicorn worker processes launched by pavesrv. Values greater than 1 are experimental, allowed only in dev mode, and may corrupt data; packaged production startup rejects them.

Reject general request bodies above this many MB with 413 before routing or authentication; 0 disables the cap. Documents use ingest.max_file_size_mb. Archive restore authenticates before upload and is exempt.
Uvicorn keep-alive timeout in seconds.
Serve the interactive OpenAPI/Swagger UI (the /ui bundle and FastAPI /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json). Null uses the startup policy: enabled in dev, disabled in production.
Base stderr log level.

Destination for structured operation logs: null/off, stdout, or a file path. A new file is created mode 0640 (its directory 0750) because every line names a tenant and collection. PaveDB does not rotate it; rotate externally, e.g. logrotate with copytruncate.
Destination for uvicorn access logs: null/off, stdout, or a file path.
Logger namespaces forced to DEBUG level.
Logger namespaces made one level more verbose than the base log level.
Noisy dependency logger namespaces made one level quieter than the base log level.
Display instance name used by the API metadata and UI.
Description used by the API metadata and UI.
